page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column; running head at top; marginal notes in the right margin (cut off at the scan edge and not legible) and a few marks in the left margin near the foot; catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: exemplo apud Spartanos, quod de Anaxandridâ rege Leontis filio ab Herodoto memoriæ proditum est. Is enim solus Spartiatarum duas simul uxores habuit, & ex utraque liberos genuit legitimos, qui regnum Spartæ tenuerunt. Hoc verò ille commisit non obsecutus cupidini suæ, ut solent qui contra leges delinquunt, sed invitus obsequens voluntati civitatis. Nam cum uxorem haberet unicè sibi caram, filiam sororis suæ, ut perhibet Horodotus, & ex ea liberos non suscipere[illegible, ~8 letters], nomine civitatis monitus ab ephoris fuit, ut conjugem aliam non sterilem duceret, ne stemma Eurysthenis, quod in capite ipsius ob steriles nuptias periclitari videbatur, deficeret. Et, cum amore conjugis, quam nihil deliquisse dicebat, cur divortii ignominia esset afficienda, facturum se hoc negaret, reversi ad eum ephori cum senatu, quo cum consilium ceperant, comminati sunt, ni sibi & reipubl. morem gereret, & retentâ conjuge, quam amabat, alteram ei superinduceret, liberisque gignendis daret operam, aliquid in ipsum statutum iri, quod ipsi futurum esset haud gratum. Tum cedens postulato adscivit conjugem alteram, & Cleomenem ex eâ genuit. Sed accidit paulò post secundis nuptiis jam

page.notes: Right margin: small marginal notes are present along the whole page but are cut off at the scan edge and cannot be read; only the one placeholder above marks where a note stands. Left margin, at the level of "postulato" and "& Cleomenem": faint marks and a fragment ("t", "C") that may be note signals; not legible enough to transcribe. Catchword "con-" is at the lower right and is kept out of the text. Printed "ss" forms read as long s with double-s ligatures in the original; rendered here as plain s. The word "Horodotus" is printed so (sic).
